title: Concept: Lockfile pins the public registry to a non-standard port
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile entry that reaches the public registry on an explicit non-standard port, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The port is outside the host's published service definition, so the connection may terminate on a proxy whose controls are unknown.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The port is outside the host's published service definition, so the connection may terminate on a proxy whose controls are unknown.
